beats.say: Every AI product sits on a data platform.
So loops now ask data engineers to design the data side of AI.
beats.label: The new question
beats.head: Design the data side of AI

beats.say: Three ideas: embeddings, RAG pipelines, and feature stores.
beats.label: Track 17 · AI for data engineering

options: It turns text into numbers that keep the meaning
check.why: Texts with a similar meaning get vectors that are close together.

beats.say: First: embeddings.
An embedding turns a text into a list of numbers. A vector.
beats.label: Embedding
beats.head: Text becomes a vector

beats.say: Texts with a similar meaning get vectors that sit close together.
beats.label: The useful part
beats.head: Similar meaning, close together

beats.say: A vector index finds the nearest ones fast. It trades a little accuracy for speed.
beats.label: Vector index
beats.head: Nearest neighbours, fast

check.prompt: In RAG, what happens before the model writes the answer?
options: The system retrieves the relevant chunks
check.why: Retrieve first, then generate. The model answers from the chunks it gets.

beats.say: Second: RAG. Look it up, then answer.
Split the documents into chunks. Embed them. Retrieve the best ones. Then generate the answer.
beats.label: The pipeline

beats.say: Treat it like any pipeline. It must be incremental, versioned, and safe to run again.
beats.label: For a data engineer
beats.head: Incremental, versioned, rerunnable

beats.say: And measure it. Did we retrieve the right chunks? Was the answer correct?
beats.label: Evaluation
beats.head: Measure retrieval and answers

beats.say: Third: features for a model.
A feature store serves the same feature for training and for live requests.
beats.label: Feature store
beats.head: One feature, two uses

beats.say: The trap is to train with data from the future. That is leakage.
beats.label: The trap
beats.head: Data from the future

beats.say: So join each row to the feature values known at that moment. Point in time.
beats.label: The fix
beats.head: A point-in-time join

beats.say: Last: model calls cost money.
Version the prompts. Cache repeated calls. And trace every request.
beats.label: Three habits

beats.say: Quick recap of AI for data engineering.
Embeddings keep meaning. RAG retrieves, then generates. And features need point-in-time joins.
beats.label: AI for data engineering
